name: Birthday Car Trend: Drift In, Lean Out, Blow Out the Candles
blurb: The birthday car trend is a birthday cake POV reel from Instagram: a friend holds a cake with lit candles, a car drifts or pulls up right behind it, the driver leans out of the window and blows out the candles, and the clip freezes in black and white.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 8 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: the same empty desert lot with dark tire marks on the ground and a low sunset sky, the same one handheld first-person camera of the friend who holds the cake with both hands at the bottom of the frame, the same timing and moves, the same two-tier white buttercream birthday cake with piped edges and about twenty tall thin lit candles, the same dark-red boxy luxury SUV that drifts in with tire smoke, and the same switch to a black-and-white freeze right after the candles go out. The ONLY change: the driver in the black turtleneck top, who leans out of the driver's window and blows out the candles, is now the person in [Image 1].

The driver = the person in [Image 1], in EVERY frame where the driver shows: copy the exact face from [Image 1] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles), exactly as in the photo. The hair that blows in the wind is the hair of [Image 1]: its color, length and style. NO long dark hair unless [Image 1] shows it. The driver wears the clothes from [Image 1]; if [Image 1] shows only the head, a plain black top. The same real person in every frame, so their friends recognize them at once, also while they lean out with hair across the face, while they blow, and in the black-and-white freeze. Never morph, never drift back to the original woman's face.

THE MOVES, second by second, exactly as in [Video 1]:
00:00-00:02: two hands hold the cake close to the camera, the candles burn, far away the vehicle comes toward us across the lot, leaving white tire smoke.
00:02-00:03: the vehicle drifts in fast and swings sideways in a cloud of tire smoke.
00:03-00:04: it slides past just behind the cake; the driver is visible at the wheel through the open window.
00:04-00:05: it stops sideways right behind the cake, the open driver's window just above the candles; the driver leans out of the window.
00:05-00:06: the driver leans further out toward the camera, the hair blowing in the wind, and blows out all the candles at once; thin white smoke rises.
00:06-00:07.8: the picture turns black and white and freezes on that moment.

Real live-action phone footage at golden hour, clear face, no distortion.

Avoid: any text, captions, names, numbers or titles over the picture, letters on the cake, brand badges, logos or lettering on the vehicle, a readable number plate, watermarks, extra people, morphing, facial distortion.

Anatomy rules: one head only, on the driver's own shoulders. Exactly one person in the vehicle, plus the two hands of the friend who holds the cake. Two arms and five fingers on each hand. One cake, one vehicle. A face never appears on hands, the vehicle or clothes.
